name: Spaceship ffc6a106 on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003
description: A period-26 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003 (touching neighbours), 17 to 26 cells, moving one lattice step every 26 generations (c/26). It runs the same way in the 16 rules from B45679/S3478 to B4,5,6,7,9,10/S0,1,3,4,7,8,10; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k2-004, k3-010 and k3-016. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-010 (seen once). To our knowledge not reported before.
